text:
Emma: Heads up — multiple hosted API customers reporting 502/504s since ~08:15 UTC. Example request id r_abc123. Gateway logs show memcached/redis timeouts and lots of upstream 5xx.
Raj: I'm seeing a spike in cache connection errors from prefix-cache (redis-primary-3). Logs show connection reset / MOVED responses. 5xx spike aligns ~08:14.
Lee: Checking dashboards now — redis-primary-3 latency and connection reset rate are through the roof. Evictions and blocked clients high.
OpsBot: ALERT prefix-cache-pool latency >200ms, timeout rate 60% over last 5m — alert id alert-5521.
Kai: Wasn't there a prefix-routing change deployed last night? @Lee any chance of distribution skew?
Lee: Yes, prefix-routing v2 rolled at 02:30. Initial look: key distribution skewed, a handful of hot prefixes are ending up on the same shard (redis-primary-3).
Raj: Reconfig'd gateway to short-circuit prefix-cache for hosted-api-prod as a temporary mitigation: set FEATURE_BYPASS_PREFIX_CACHE=true on the gateway config and redeployed to prod.
Emma: Thanks. I opened a CS escalation tracker for affected customers (cust A/B/C). Link: http://intranet.internal/incidents/987 — I'll update customers once we have green.
Marta: Confirming affected: Cust-A (high volume), Cust-B, Cust-C reported 502s and timeouts. I told them we're investigating and suggested exponential-retry with 30s backoff for now.
Kai: Mitigation proposal: restart redis-primary-3 + scale replicas + revert prefix-routing change if needed. Also increase client connect/retry timeouts to 1s to avoid tight failure loops.
Lee: Starting rolling restart of redis-primary-3 now. Command:```kubectl rollout restart statefulset/redis-primary -n infra```Started at 08:27 UTC.
OpsBot: deployment/statefulset redis-primary rollout status: SUCCESS (all pods ready) — timestamp 08:31 UTC.
Raj: After bypassing prefix-cache and restarting the node, gateway 5xx rate is trending down — 5xxs back to baseline by 08:33. Will keep monitoring.
Emma: :thumbsup: I'll notify customers and mark the escalation acknowledged. Any immediate follow-ups?
Lee: We should schedule a postmortem to root cause the prefix hash distribution bug and add hot-key detection + throttling. Also add a local fallback cache in the gateway for a small TTL to reduce blast radius.
Kai: +1 on canarying prefix-routing changes and adding automated hot-key alarms. Filing incident INC-2026-045 and will create an action item list.
Emma: Thanks team — leaving notes for support handoff. I'll close the incident once metrics hold for 30m.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-045 opened by Emma at 08:35 UTC.
